: Baseline scalar amplitude, the fluid’s tension (e.g.,  cosmic,  atomic).
: Effective viscosity, the fluid’s resistance ( ).
: Effective energy, context-specific (e.g.,  for Pt L-shell).
: Scalar perturbations, fluid ripples linking scales.
: Scalar GW strain, longitudinal waves ( ).
: Biological processing units (e.g.,  neurons).
